LED Moving Text

Make your message easy to spot

Turn your device into a bright, full-screen sign for meeting people, events, or quiet conversations. Pick a still, scrolling, or bouncing display, then present or export it.

What do the free and Premium versions include?

Free includes unlimited text entry and full-screen display, still and horizontal scrolling, left/right direction, speed and text-size controls, basic high-contrast styles, 5 starter situations, and up to 3 saved boards. One Premium purchase unlocks unlimited boards, custom templates, the complete font and Aurora Pearl style collection, vertical and bouncing movement, spacing and visual effects, photo backgrounds, beat response, countdowns, and on-device MP4/GIF export. There are no recurring subscription payments.

Clear signs, set up your way

  • Still, scrolling, or bouncing

    Hold the words in place, keep them scrolling, or bounce them between the edges.

  • Movement in four directions

    Send text left, right, up, or down and tune the pace for the distance.

  • Styles and ready-made layouts

    Choose legible colours, LED dot treatments, and templates for everyday situations.

  • Visual countdown

    Show a straightforward countdown whenever timing is important.

  • Beat-aware display

    If you switch it on, the microphone can make the visuals react live to nearby beats.

  • Export to MP4 or GIF

    Render an MP4 video or GIF locally on your device and decide where to share it.

Designed to work on your device

Your sign text, styling, selected photos, and media rendering remain on the device. There is no account to create and no developer cloud involved.
